description: This file is a PHP source script for handling the editing of managed (allowed) devices within a parental control web interface. It includes server-side logic to retrieve device data, manages form display, and client-side JavaScript to handle validation and form submission.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves string values from configuration or data sources, used for obtaining device info and UI strings.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Fetches extended key-value data, typically device parameters based on provided base keys.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_get
methods.description: Processes device data items to convert time and day information into a usable format.
